objectives.name: Obtain the Burning Ashes from Ignited Revenants.

title: Immortal Inferno
description:
Name: [Ignis](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/ignis.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Burning Arena, located in Infernal's Maw, entered through Eye of Flame
Estimated Size: Large
Behavior: The strongest of Cataclysm's bosses, Ignis can deal additional damage depending on the opponent's maximum health. In addition, he can absorb health through sword based attacks. Frequently slashes with his sword, afflicting those hit with [Blazing Brand](image:cataclysm:textures/mob_effect/blazing_brand.png), which reduces the affected's armor. He can also slam his shield into the ground to create shockwaves and ram forward to stun opponents. His most deadly attack is skewering the opponent on his sword. This attack is deadly but telegraphed by him reering his sword back. He can also create pillars of fire and fireballs that can be redirected. His shield provides constant cover, making it impossible to attack from Ignis's left. After taking enough damage, Ignis's flames turn blue and he becomes much stronger and more aggresive. Once severely damaged, he abandons his shield, making it possible to attack him from any angle. He will start to use a large overhead slam with his sword, creating a line of pillars of flames.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly, prepare for the worst and bring effect neutralizers like milk
